resolution_notes: Verifier A’s free_tier_limits claim is correct for current Shodan pricing: free accounts get 0 API query credits; Membership is required for API access. Official pricing/account pages document this; the original entry’s vague “limited API access” wording is inaccurate. All other fields stand as confirmed by both verifiers.
free_tier_limits: Free plan: 0 API query credits (no REST API access). Membership (paid) required for API query credits; higher plans add filters, streaming, and scan credits—see shodan.io/pricing and account plan.
